Updates `tsdown` from 0.23.5 to 0.23.7
Release notes

Sourced from tsdown's releases.

v0.23.7

[!NOTE] v0.23.6 was skipped on purpose: its release failed, so this release follows v0.23.5 directly.

Notes

rolldown-plugin-dts is now v0.30. Full details are in the rolldown-plugin-dts v0.30.0 release notes.

Migration

dts.entry only filters entries. Only entries that match get declaration files. A matching file that is not an entry no longer gets its own declaration file. To emit declarations for such a file, add it to entry. The filter now applies to .d.cts as well as .d.mts.

dts.entry is resolved from cwd. Patterns are relative to tsdown's cwd, the same as the top-level entry, instead of process.cwd(). This only matters when the two differ, e.g. in workspace builds. Set dts.cwd to override it.

dts.emitDtsOnly and dts.dtsInput are deprecated. Use dts.dtsOnly instead. The old names still work but log a warning.

Highlights

  • dts: An entry's file-level doc comment is kept in its declaration file.
  • dts: Declaration files no longer contain a dangling sourceMappingURL.
  • dts: CJS declaration builds no longer emit a throwaway JS chunk. With the tsc generator, they build one program for all entries.
  • tsgo (experimental): Diagnostics show code context in color terminals, and packages from project references and files outside the tsconfig directory now get declarations.
  • Agent skill: The npm package now ships a small tsdown skill. pnpm 12.11+ can link it into agent skill directories, and it points agents to the full skill on GitHub for the installed version.

   🚀 Features

  • Ship a skill facade in the npm package  -  by @​sxzzbot in rolldown/tsdown#1122 (6ad05)
  • dts: Upgrade rolldown-plugin-dts to v0.30  -  by @​sxzzbot in rolldown/tsdown#1123 (d351b)

Updates `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin` from 1.6.0 to 1.8.0
Release notes

Sourced from @​cloudflare/vitest-plugin's releases.

@​cloudflare/vitest-plugin@​1.8.0

Minor Changes

  • #16682 5966749 Thanks @​ghostwriternr! - Run the Containers that cloudflare.config.ts attaches to Durable Objects

    Previously, projects that load cloudflare.config.ts through the config option ran those Durable Objects without their Containers. The plugin now prepares the Containers' images and runs them, as it does for Wrangler configuration files. Dockerfile and build context paths are relative to the directory that contains cloudflare.config.ts.

    cloudflare.config.ts has no setting that disables local Containers, so, as with the Vite plugin, projects with Container-backed Durable Objects need Docker to run their tests.

Patch Changes

  • #16824 877b249 Thanks @​jamesopstad! - Move streaming tail consumers to experimental.streamingTailConsumers in cloudflare.config.ts

    Streaming Tail Workers are now declared in a separate, experimental list instead of with streaming: true on a tailConsumers entry. tailConsumers now only lists Tail Workers with a tail() handler. This is a breaking change to the experimental config API: move each entry that set streaming: true to experimental.streamingTailConsumers, without the streaming field.

    export default defineConfig({
  worker: {
    tailConsumers: [{ worker: "tail-worker" }],
    experimental: {
      streamingTailConsumers: [{ worker: "streaming-tail-worker" }],
    },
  },
});

    Fields under experimental may change or be removed without a major version bump. The wrangler-to-cf codemod now converts streaming_tail_consumers to experimental.streamingTailConsumers.

  • #16734 c47cca7 Thanks @​matingathani! - Fix CommonJS dependencies being loaded as ES modules under Vitest 5 inline projects

    A dependency with its own "type": "commonjs" package.json was treated as an ES module when an earlier .js file elsewhere in the project had been classified by the project's "type": "module" package.json. The dependency then failed at import with errors such as Cannot set properties of undefined or exports is not defined. The nearest package.json now always decides how a .js file is loaded.

  • Updated dependencies [877b249, 69e650c]:

    • miniflare@5.20261110.1-beta
    • wrangler@4.160.1

@​cloudflare/vitest-plugin@​1.7.0

Minor Changes

  • #15695 d437be3 Thanks @​ghostwriternr! - Run the Containers that the Wrangler configuration attaches to Durable Objects

    Previously, the plugin disabled Containers, so those Durable Objects ran without ctx.container. The plugin now builds or pulls the Containers' images before each project's tests run and gives the Durable Objects a real ctx.container, so these projects now need Docker. To keep running their tests without Docker, set dev.enable_containers to false in the Wrangler configuration, which disables the Containers. Cloudflare-managed registry images are not supported yet.

Patch Changes

  • #16810 cdc970b Thanks @​dependabot! - Update DEFAULT_COMPAT_DATE to 2026-11-10

    Use the bundled workerd release's compatibility date by default when scaffolding new projects or when no compatibility date is configured.

Updates `wrangler` from 4.158.0 to 4.160.1
Release notes

Sourced from wrangler's releases.

wrangler@4.160.1

Patch Changes

  • Updated dependencies [877b249, 69e650c]:
    • miniflare@5.20261110.1-beta

wrangler@4.160.0

Minor Changes

  • #16760 cb9534f Thanks @​petebacondarwin! - Support forwarded Wrangler development server options in the experimental cf-wrangler delegate

    cf dev can now forward options such as --inspector-port 9229, --ip, --var, and --persist-to to the Wrangler development runtime. The delegate reuses Wrangler's dev option definitions and validation while retaining project config discovery, --mode environment selection, local development, and its .cloudflare/state default. Invalid option combinations produce a single-line usage error and exit code 2 before starting the server.

    Place server options that overlap cf's global options after --, for example cf dev -- --local --persist-to "custom state". Config and script overrides, whole-worker remote development, and Wrangler's global options remain unsupported.

  • #16739 6af492e Thanks @​GregBrimble! - Add custom Cloudflare API headers through CLOUDFLARE_API_HEADERS

    Set CLOUDFLARE_API_HEADERS to a JSON object such as {"X-Custom-Header":"value"} to add headers to Cloudflare API requests. Custom headers override existing unprotected request headers, body and transport headers are protected, and header values outside the diagnostic allowlist remain redacted regardless of log sanitization settings.

Patch Changes

  • #16810 cdc970b Thanks @​dependabot! - Update DEFAULT_COMPAT_DATE to 2026-11-10

    Use the bundled workerd release's compatibility date by default when scaffolding new projects or when no compatibility date is configured.

  • #16810 cdc970b Thanks @​dependabot! - Update dependencies of "miniflare", "wrangler"

    The following dependency versions have been updated:

    Dependency From To
    @​cloudflare/workers-types ^5.20261109.1 ^5.20261110.1
    workerd 1.20261109.1 1.20261110.1

  • #16709 022ee9d Thanks @​petebacondarwin! - Keep local Container images available for upload retries

    Keep prebuilt local image tags available until the caller finishes uploading the Worker and deploying its Container applications, so a later failure can be retried without rebuilding. When image push commands request cleanup, remove the source tag only after the push succeeds.

  • #16740 44b39b0 Thanks @​GregBrimble! - Redact header values outside a safe diagnostic allowlist, regardless of log sanitization settings.

    Apply the same filtering to request, response, and request-options diagnostics. Strip X-Auth-Key alongside Authorization when forwarding local artifact Git requests.

  • #16758 325dc69 Thanks @​petebacondarwin! - Fix JavaScript configuration parsing for Svelte projects using object spread

    Use a parser that supports object spread when updating JavaScript configuration files. This prevents configuration failures for Svelte projects using Drizzle or Better Auth and other framework configurations containing modern JavaScript syntax.

    Vite autoconfiguration reports a configuration error when an object spread, computed property, or accessor after the plugins array could override the Cloudflare plugin. Place the effective plugins array after these properties before retrying autoconfiguration.
